rest-pose rewards (balance, feet, upright) must cover ALL frames after the main event; r09-r11 walk-off / squat started exactly at the settle->stand label switch where they stopped. Detect: quant E per-segment drift.
a template fix exp(-err/std) with err >> std gives no gradient (r08: signal 1e-5). Detect: quant C signal < 0.05; fix: std of the order of the current error.
decided reward terms missing from the training run (r08 old process). Detect: quant F.
state knobs can be mutated after a round trained; diff the training logs (r09 curriculum).
the scalar score can rank the better policy lower (r10 end-tilt threshold); the decider sets the start checkpoint.
never-trained latency: 20 ms -> 70 % success, 40 ms -> 0 % (r14). Fix: randomised actuator delay.
arm speed / torso spin / action change after the event (r7)
pelvis-velocity term with scale 0.6 m/s (0.2 gave no gradient at 1.2 m/s, r10)
feet / tilt / waist limits after the event
global anchor position: height only after the event (r6 walked to the reference landing spot)
global orientation: tilt only after the event (r7 waist 115 deg)
reference padded with a rest-pose tail
_airborne: whole body > 5 cm and pelvis > 0.45 m (r2: lying + kicking counted as airborne)
rotation rewarded only when truly airborne
vertical speed only while both feet load
feet > max_d apart in the air (r4 star shape)
hip roll / yaw / knee separation limits (r7)
land / land_balance / feet_together also in stand_after (r12 fix of the r09-r11 walk-off)
landing = end of the FIRST airborne run (r9 hop after landing gave landing_offset 67)
hips one-sided, knees two-sided (r6 knees 2.9 rad)
mjlab delay buffer backfilled reset rows with an all-zero target -> 0 rad commands at every episode start; fixed with hold-pose (r15)

the reference itself must pass every active termination (cartwheel_2 r01: the aerial landing terminations term_flight_spread / term_leg_twist fired on all 10 frames of the reference's own wide landing, so every correct cartwheel was cut off at touch-down). Guard: harness.ref_audit refuses the round.

an absolute (not reference-relative) reward must pay the reference itself >= 0.8 inside its gate, else it pulls the policy away from the skill (cartwheel_2 r01: flip_leg_sym 0.04, flip_land_balance 0.62). Detect: ref_term_audit 'reference_pays' (logged per round as ref_audit).

planted feet level and on the floor in still stances: ground_fix moves only the root, so an uneven monocular stance left one STRAIGHT leg's sole 2.4-3.8 cm up for the whole held final pose (cartwheel_2). Fix: legs + root height only, knees >= 0.1 rad.
the round score must fit the family: the aerial score pays airborne time / pelvis rise / 300 deg, meaningless for a cartwheel (rotation then relative to the reference's own).
GMR smplx_to_g1 left-arm rotation offsets are wrong (left elbow locked at -1.05): arms matched by position (--arm_pos 50) + elbow branch escape; left hand error 22 -> 1.3 cm.
palm (not fingertips) on the floor while a hand is planted: wrist joints only, multi-start.
hand contacts count for the root height (G1 arms scaled 0.8 vs legs 0.9 left the palms 4-12 cm up).
stock G1 non-foot collision geoms have condim 1 (frictionless): hands need condim 3, friction 0.6.
stance limits relative to the reference's own landing stance (cartwheel_2 ankles 0.68 m apart vs 0.23 m backflip).

a from-frame-0 failure does not say WHICH part is not learned: start the policy at several reference frames (cartwheel_2 r02: from frame 60 on 75 % complete and stand, the entry onto the hands lost within 5 steps). Automatic each round (quant A3); put start-state weight on the failing segments.

grounding the root per frame on whichever contact is planted jumps when the contact switches (cartwheel_2: foot -> hand, root -7 cm in 2 frames, ~2 g down with a foot on the floor): root offset by bounded least squares (no penetration) with a vertical-acceleration penalty.

the G1 arm is short relative to the body: with a smooth root the palm stayed 6-25 cm up while the human's was planted, the reference hovered over one foot for ~0.25 s. Arm joints only (7 per arm) put the planted palm on the floor (straight arms, as in the video).
